_note: Pod-local dimensions (D2). Shared numbers (pod LE, length, height, base, board thickness, pack size, spar station, pitot tip x/z) come from redesign/params/params.json; these are the pod-only ones. Read by subsystems/pod/fusion/pod.py, team/D2/pod_data.py and team/D2/pod_claims.py. Metres unless stated.

width_m.note: params.json pod.size_m[1] is 0.10 until A1 decides CR-D2-01: 52 mm bay + two 37 mm side channels (FC right, airspeed/RX/power left) + 4.8 mm walls

bay_min_m.note: inside L x W x H the pack bay must keep

tray_floor_t_m.note: PETG, 5 layers at 0.2 mm, backed by the foam-board floor

pad_t_m.note: anti-slip silicone pads under the pack

pad_len_m.note: one pad per strap station, centred on the strap

window_border_m.note: tray-floor lightening windows: border to ends and slots (x), to the guides (y)

guide_h_m.note: bay side guides above the tray floor

slot_wall_m.note: foam left between the pod recess end and the spar-slot front face; sets the aft stop

lead_notch_m.note: width, start height above the tray: XT60 and balance leads leave the pack aft face over/through the stop wall

spacer_set_m.note: trim spacers (POD-008), sum <= aft travel; each goes in front of or behind the pack: 0-23 mm in 8 steps

strap_from_front_m.note: strap centres from the pack front at the forward stop (quarter points of a 140 mm pack)

strap_slot_m.note: x length (strap 20 mm + 11 mm so the strap follows the pack over the trim travel) x y width

plate_t_m.note: FC and avionics plates (part of POD-002)

fc_centre_x_m.note: right channel; F3 confirms the board (CR-D2-06)

fc_pattern_m.note: M3 square pattern placeholder until F3 gives the footprint

boss_d_m.note: boss for an M3 x 5.7 brass heat-set insert (4.0 mm bore)

avn_plate_x_m.note: left channel front: airspeed sensor on 2 x M2 bosses; RX, UBEC and power items tape to the foam floor behind it

hatch_aft_x_m.note: hatch opening ends 3 mm aft of the aft stop; fixed aft deck behind it

lip_m.note: nose lip length x thickness; the hatch tongue slides under it

latch_tab_m.note: hook-and-loop latch tab, overlap on the aft deck x width

foot_y_m.note: handle foot (spar saddle) span each side

tongue_cheek_frac.note: saddle cheeks stop 0.8 r above the spar axis

tie_y_m.note: spar tie stations, each through its handle foot

grip_gap_m.note: finger room between the deck and the grip

socket_boss_m.note: mast socket on the grip: outer square, depth, bore square

mast_m.note: square side, bore, height above the socket

gps_plate_m.note: square side, thickness; 25 mm GPS taped on top

pitot_y_m.note: left side-channel centre; params avionics.pitot_tip_xyz_m y is 0 until F3/B4/A1 accept

socket_m.note: pitot socket: block square, bore, length inside the nose wall, collar outside

boom_od_m.note: pitot boom OD the socket bore is sized for

cable_exit_m.note: aft-wall harness exits each side: y from, y to, z from, z to

fill.note: effective density fraction: plates <= 2 mm print solid; blocks 3 perimeters + 25 % infill

bought_g.source: EST (catalogue class values; weigh at build, T-D2-WEIGH)
